notes.title: New Patch! v1.1.0
notes.content:
New game mode "Dreams"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/0438c9205a8dc0c642d332c770279768019dfd36.png

Dream map is presented in the form of a grid and consists of many encounters, after completing one of them, neighboring ones are unlocked, and the previous ones become inactive. In dreams, you will meet both groups of monsters and wandering merchants or altars.

In this mode, you have to control the level of sanity, this parameter affects the strength of the monsters and the number of rewards at the end. You lose sanity with each completed dream and also when using some skills.

To win, you need to complete three stages of dreams, you must defeat the boss to proceed to the next stage, you can fight him at any time, but in order to win, you need to carefully prepare. After killing the boss, you transfer to the next, more difficult stage, but along with the strength of the monsters, the quality of rewards also grows. Your goal is to complete all stages while maintaining the maximum amount of sanity possible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/26c1fd2024af7a4bd95f24b5682315db06779ae5.png

Completing dream, rewards you with equipment that have unique passive effects and resources to make it even more powerful. Also you can unlock new talents that will help you at the start.

notes.title: Tower of Ascension available on "test" branch.
notes.content:
First playable version of Tower of Ascension available on test branch. 

How to activate test branch:
1. In your Steam library, right-click the game, choose Properties
2. Click the "Betas" tab, choose the beta entry from the drop-down list.
3. Steam will now start to update your game files to the currently available beta version.

Every character above level 20 will receive an item "Tower Key" every time you enter town, this item unlocks new scenario.

PS I have one more week to make improvements so please leave a feedback :)

notes.title: New endgame mode (WIP)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/2a9a7065e0a263b7357a266b922e122a26a4549c.png

Hey everyone, finally I have something to share with you. Currently i'm working on a new end-game mode called "Tower of Ascension" (name may be changed in future), in this mode monsters are getting stronger with every floor and every 5th floor you will face a guardian of the tower.

How to get there
To get to the tower you need a key, you can get it from monsters as a random drop (same as treasure maps) or buy it inside the tower after defeating a guardian.

Monsters
Mostly they are the same as in nightmares, but much stronger.

Guardians
Guardians are strong bosses with 5 skills each. Guardians have rage resource and will use "ultimate" skills. Currently I've created 4 of them but later i will create more, at least one for each possible "class".

Ascended Knight (Sword + Shield)
Medium damage, very tanky but have no healing skills.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/7b1f0de777be351c9092051532bc310131124777.png

Ascended Assassin (Dual Daggers)
High damage, high mobility, medium health.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/40f671bdcdee26b310bda021937e5f300846900f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/0765adcfce4c654c1c64c4375257290e33e7ef79.png

Ascended Hunter (Bow)
Medium damage, low mobility, pets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/1a904f69248e570c267fba8443815b8f78060943.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/4eafe10706ba7c8424382b679fc5429846db5121.png

Ascended Gunslinger (Dual Revolvers)
High damage, high mobility, low health.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/a8862e5faf437478f46657383f6f188eea8ff23a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/6c5242cb5db7957d8cb1f8990cf8f3dcc1fdd8c6.png

Rewards
Killing enemies gives you a new currency called "Soul Shard", you can spend it after defeating a tower guardian. Stronger enemies give you more soul shards. You can buy set pieces, legendaries, legendary gems, orbs of ascension (allows you to upgrade your items) and other stuff.

Summary
As i said earlier, this mode is in development and any of its aspects may be changed in the future.

notes.title: Further development
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Unfortunately I can't continue developing Dark Bestiary at full time, I've found a job and now I have 1-2 free hours every day :( I will still continue development but it will be more chaotic and unregular than before.

Here is small recap of recent month:
- Scrolls of Enchantment - new droppable items that allow you to upgrade your gear, similar to gems but some of them have unique effects.
- Alchemy split into potions and transmutation
- Lots of bugs fixed, most of them was minor but some was really painful like summons that blocks exit.

I really want to thank you for your feedback and suggestions, i have a huuuuge ToDo list :D

Thank you for playing Dark Bestiary <3

notes.title: New Patch! v0.6.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone, glad to present you first Dark Bestiary major update. This patch introduces: relics, alchemy, masteries, story, attribute rework, monster modifiers, new level cap, new nightmare levels, new item sets and many more.

Relics
Relics are special items that becomes stronger over time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/f4a699a848cc5f09963499c0215275dfa85332ee.png

Alchemy
This new option, available at Alchemist, allows you to combine two or more items to get an interesting result.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/1df8d935f0a6f98ead593461e23b7cebf00e9f10.png

Masteries
Each weapon and almost all schools of magic have a mastery associated with it. Mastery determines how good you are at using certain weapon or magic.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/5f6ca4b6d05fa4bd7c4744dd8ca42ce1b1bef42c.png

Story
Campaign have been updated with scripted events and dialogues.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/35755029282a684c510b5535e80c239214ac154e.png

Attribute Rework
Old attribute set was unable to support hybrid classes like paladin or battlemage, you couldn't be good at magic and fighting at the same time, but new attributes are more flexible and give you more freedom.


 Might - increases your attack and spell power
 Ferocity - increases your critical hit damage
 Precision - increases your critical hit chance
 Constitution - increases your health


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/328ed6bdb42e730261a74c5b572c22ac37415bab.png

Monster Modifiers
In nightmare levels you can meet stronger versions of monsters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34906570/af1b8c38779e10f6c076ee9083a307d17eed7fca.png

 Combat Rage: now procs when using skills. Strength bonus replaced with damage increase. No longer stackable
 Insight: now increases critical strike chance instead of intelligence
 Concentration: now procs when using any skill, not just magic and increases damage by 6% incread of spell power
 Dual Wield Expert: damage bonus reduced from 15% to 6%
 Cull the Weak: damage bonus reduced from 25% to 20%
 Headhunter: damage bonus increased from 3% to 10%
 Lock and Load: chance reduced from 20% to 15%
 Veteran: now increases your health and damage by 10%, was 15% strength and constitution
 Master Summoner: now gains 15% flat bonus to pets, instead of max attribute fraction
 Restoration: now gains 10% flat bonus to heal and shield power, instead of max attribute fraction
 Destruction: now gains 5% flat bonus magical damage, instead of max attribute fraction
 Lightning Reflexes: now gains 10% flat bonus dodge, instead of max attribute fraction
 Vampirism: bonus reduced from 6% to 4%
 Colossus Strength: now increases damage % by a fraction of your max health
 Rising Rage: damage bonus increased from 3% to 5%, removed stack count limit
 Bastion: damage reduction bonus reduced from 10% to 6%
 Toughness: reworked, now gains 40% damage reduction while health is less than 40%
 Hardened Skin: renamed to Resilience
 Heavy Armor: renamed to hardened skin, now gains flat bonus to physical damage reduction
 Enrage: reworked, now reduces all action cost when health drops below 40%


New Skills

 Dispel Magic
 Stormhammer
 Static Field
 Freezing Trap

 Taunt
 Wild Growth

 Flytrap attack formula

notes.title: Upcoming features in patch v0.6.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I've started working on major update that includes new features:

 Reliquary and relics. Relics are special items that can be leveled up and reliquary is the place where you store them.
 Narrative, dialogues and story.
 New level cap.


It will take me from 2 to 3 weeks to complete, but reliquary will be available soon on "test" branch.

notes.title: New Patch! v0.5.5
notes.content:
Global

 Forging: Secondary attributes now scales less.
 Dexterity: critical hit chance reduced from 0.25% to 0.125%
 Strength: critical hit damage reduced from 0.33% to 0.25%
 Defense: damage reduction reduced from 0.5% to 0.3%
 Resistance:  damage reduction reduced from 0.5% to 0.3%
 Constitution: health increased from 15 to 20
 Reduced bleeding damage from 3% to 2% of max health
 Bleeding and poison effects now stacks up to 5 times
 Item level of all legendaries reduced from 3 to 2
 Global damage formula changed: melee damage increased, magic and ranged damage reduced
 Glancing strike damage reduced from 50% to 25%.
 Elemental damage bonus from items increased.


Items

 Stormbringer: maximum stack count of "Electrified Blade" increased from 5 to 11
 Runestone quality increased to Rare was Magic.
 Dark Sword: Quality increased to Legendary with unique effect.
 Elemental Quiver: Quality reduced to Unique, was Legendary, removed random elemental damage.
 Shield Ring: Quality changed to Unique was Legendary, stats balance changed, removed skill.
 Lens: added random stats.
 Adamantite Destroyer: added random stats
 Marten's Book: renamed to Grimoire and added random stats.
 Grim Reaper: renamed to scythe and added random stats.
 Lightbringer: damage type changed to holy, AOE radius increased.


Scenarios

 Reworked nightmare rewards.
 Added Nightmare VIII.
 Patrol: Clean-up added Augment Sphere reward.


Skills

 Ghostly Soul: cooldown reduced from 4 to 2.
 Piercing shot: cooldown increased from 0 to 3 turns.
 Chain Lightning: added damage variance.
 Black Hole: action point cost reduced from 4 to 2.


Monsters

 Blood Transfusion effect increased from 20% of max health to 50%


Talents

 Singularity now restores 6AP instead of 8.
 Overheal: shield amount now limited to your max hp.
 Insight: 10% chance to increase intelligence by 15% for 2 turns.
 Combat Rage: 10% chance to increase strength by 5% for 2 turns. Stacks up to 3 times.
 Lock and Load: Now 20% chance to restore 4 action points.
 Destruction: now gains spell power instead of magic damage.


Skill Sets

 Stormcaller skill set bonus now applies "Shock" effect that increases incoming damage instead of stun.


Improvements

 Stack size for all ingredients increased to 999999
 Stash now looks like inventory.


Fixes

 Thorns not applying if damage was absorbed.
 Cryomancer and Stormcaller skill set bonus procs from dots.
 Piercing shot not applying bleeding.
 If damage was absorbed on take damage effect not applying.
 Dropping blueprints that already known.
 Last stand not resetting after death.
 Circle of Elements buff not removing when accessory unequipped.
 Cloak of Flame missing resistances.
 Fixed armor/magic penetration mechanics.
 Dummy units appears on the next map.


New

 Items.
 Blueprints.
 Item suffixes.
 Ingredients.
 Background: Gunslinger.
 Potion of Might: increases damage by 10% for 2 turns.
 Potion of Protection: reduces incoming damage by 15% for 2 turns.


Removed

 Potion of Strength.
 Potion of Dexterity.
 Potion of Constitution.
 Potion of Intelligence.
